name: Thomas Heart

text.trigger: A player uses the ability of a weapon item card while Thomas Heart is in play. The player who controls Thomas Heart makes the choice.
text.vignette: The echo of the shot rolls back off the alley wall and something in Thomas shifts, as if a fuse at the back of his skull has finally burned through. He starts to shout and does not stop.

options.lash-out: Thomas deals out 4 wounds among the other survivors at his location, one at a time (his controller picks). If nobody else is there, nothing happens.
options.send-for-medics: The players together remove 2 Medicine cards from their hands from the game. If they cannot, the first option happens instead.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #40; Three options. The choice belongs to the controller of Thomas Heart (decider).
